PLEASE TAKE NOTICE that the defendants, ANTHONY F. FERRARA and 
METRO-NORTH COMMUTER RAILROAD, by their attorneys MILBER MAKRIS 
PLOUSADIS & SEIDEN, LLP, in response to the initial demand of plaintiff, dated January 2, 
2025, hereby respond as follows: 
ACCIDENT/INCIDENT REPORTS:  
Annexed hereto is the Metro-North Railroad Incident Report. 
PHOTOGRAPHS:   
Annexed hereto are five (5) photographs of the vehicles involved in the subject accident. 
WITNESS INFORMATION:  
Kyle Pullano, Metro-North Employee, was a passenger in responding defendants’ 
vehicle. 
INSURANCE COVERAGE:  
Insurance coverage information to be provided under separate cover.  
 
PLEASE TAKE FURTHER NOTICE, that the responding defendants reserve the right 
to amend and/or supplement the responses contained herein should new or additional discovery
